findings.title: docs/delivery/agents.md was not updated for D-022: its invocation command still passes the prompt as a positional argument without --input-format stream-json --replay-user-messages, and its list of run-binding conditions omits the CLI-replayed prompt
findings.reproduction: git show e11b5f08dfa8b6cbe8716964e3412e17697234aa:docs/delivery/agents.md | grep -c -e '--replay-user-messages' -> 0. The command block under 'Invocation mechanism (decision D-003)' still reads 'claude -p --agent <agent> ... --output-format stream-json --verbose "<pointer to the assignment file>"'. tools/agents/run-agent.sh (lines 108 and 117) instead pipes user_message "$PROMPT" into 'claude -p ... --input-format stream-json --replay-user-messages --output-format stream-json --verbose'. The paragraph's final sentence lists the conditions under which the validator refuses a run (complete, hash-consistent, same role and stage, exact assignment, post-freeze start, successful result). It does not mention D-022's requirement of a CLI-replayed prompt (isReplay: true) carrying the run_id and session_id, which tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs checkInvocation now enforces. Also, the round-6 edit put 'The validator does not trust tool_authored alone. It replays ...' directly before 'It snapshots the tree before and after the run. For review roles, it auto-commits ...', so 'It' now grammatically refers to the validator although it means the runner. Automated: docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/round-7/15-agents-md-vs-evidence.log (3 FAIL lines).
findings.expected: agents.md describes the invocation mechanism the runner actually uses and the conditions the validator actually enforces. Update the command block to the stream-json/replay form, add the replayed-prompt condition (D-022) to the binding list, and make the runner the explicit subject of the snapshot/auto-commit/records sentences.
findings.actual: The code (run-agent.sh, rules.mjs) and decisions.md D-022 are correct and consistent. I verified D-022 independently: QA7-N70..N74 and N83, plus this run's own live transcript, which carries the replayed prompt. Only agents.md, which REQ-DLV-004/006/026 cite as evidence, still describes the pre-D-022 invocation. This is documentation only, with no effect on any rule or evidence. The reporter would accept it as a Low observation.
